paragraphs.text: Old paper gives off hundreds of compounds as it ages. Together they produce the sweet, slightly sour smell that many readers like, and which no perfume has copied exactly.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Conservators use the smell as a tool. A portable device samples the air around a book and reports which compounds are present, which tells them how fast the paper is breaking down.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: The method is gentle: nothing is cut from the page, and the book need not leave the shelf. Older tests required a small piece of paper, which libraries were reluctant to give.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Results are not always easy to read. A book stored next to a window gives different figures from the same edition kept in a cool room, so conservators record where each copy has been.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: Older tests required a small piece of paper, which libraries were reluctant to give
items.prompt: an advantage over earlier methods of testing

explanation.en: Earlier tests needed a piece of paper — the advantage is in paragraph C.
explanation.kk: Бұрын қағаздан кесік алу керек болған — артықшылық C абзацында.
explanation.ru: Раньше нужно было отрезать кусочек бумаги — преимущество описано в абзаце C.

items.quote: A book stored next to a window gives different figures from the same edition kept in a cool room
items.prompt: a factor that makes the figures harder to compare

explanation.en: Storage conditions change the figures — paragraph D.
explanation.kk: Сақтау жағдайы сандарды өзгертеді — D абзацы.
explanation.ru: Условия хранения меняют цифры — абзац D.

items.quote: Old paper gives off hundreds of compounds as it ages

explanation.en: Hundreds of compounds from ageing paper cause the smell — paragraph A.
explanation.kk: Иісті ескірген қағаздың жүздеген қосылысы береді — A абзацы.
explanation.ru: Запах дают сотни соединений стареющей бумаги — абзац A.

items.quote: A portable device samples the air around a book
items.prompt: a description of the equipment used

explanation.en: A portable device samples the air — paragraph B.
explanation.kk: Тасымалды құрал ауа сынамасын алады — B абзацы.
explanation.ru: Переносной прибор берёт пробу воздуха — абзац B.
